pr_title: [wasm][testing] hosting echo server in xharness process
pr_body:
This makes WebSocket test on WASM easier to work with, by moving the tests to inner loop. In order to do that we are hosting the echo test server which the tests use, in the xharness process. Because wasm is always tested with xharness.

- build echo test server and pass it to xharness
- move networking tests to inner loop for browser
    - 110 tests enabled in System.Net.Http.Functional.Tests
    - 72 tests enabled in System.Net.WebSockets.Client.Tests
- discovers https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53591
- discovers https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53592
- discovers https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53872
- discovers https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53874
- discovers https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53876
- fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53018
- fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/53668

issue_context.title: [wasm][HTTP] TypeError: Failed to fetch
issue_context.body:
Broken tests in
- System.Net.Http.Functional.Tests.SyncHttpHandler_PostScenarioTest
- System.Net.Http.Functional.Tests.HttpClientHandler_RemoteServerTest 


Tests fail with 
```
System.Net.Http.HttpRequestException : TypeError: Failed to fetch   at System.Net.Http.BrowserHttpHandler.SendAsync(HttpRequestMessage request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   at System.Net.Http.HttpClient.<SendAsync>g__Core|83_0(HttpRequestMessage request, HttpCompletionOption completionOption, CancellationTokenSource cts, Boolean disposeCts, CancellationTokenSource pendingRequestsCts, CancellationToken originalCancellationToken)
   at System.Net.Http.Functional.Tests.HttpClientHandler_RemoteServerTest.SendAsync_SendRequestUsingMethodToEchoServerWithNoContent_MethodCorrectlySent(String method, Uri serverUri)
```

Part of the failures could be caused by lack of CORS support on the remote test server in Azure.

review_comments:
`DOTNET_TEST_HTTPHOST` -> `DOTNET_TEST_HTTP2HOST`

It would be better to extract the port number from `Http2Host`, and `Http2SecureHost` strings instead. And name these `Http2Port`, `Http2SecurePort`?
Oh, the echo server is `httpHost`, and `http2Host`. This is fine then, my bad. You could extract the value from `Host`, and `SecureHost`, but that's a nit.
The usage is together with `SecureHost` like `withPort ? Configuration.Http.SecureHost + ":" + Configuration.Http.SecurePort`

Why modify the ActiveIssues to be of this form? If the problem occurs when method is `TRACE` I think the issue can reflect that instead. The ActiveIssue attribute should skip this method from being ran, and that would reflect in the test results. I'm not sure, but would the early return indicate this test method as passing (which sounds like it shouldn't be)?
Same for the issue where method is `HEAD`

Because this is data driven test, there are many combinations. Multiple endpoints/protocols x multiple HTTP verbs.
